confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of local price levels, rolled forward to July 2026; no live listings, menus or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because summer and event-driven room rates swing widely. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.5 times beer, wine glass about 2 times beer) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. Web search was used only for the FX observation, taken from search-result summaries that attribute it to RBA exchange-rate pages; those RBA pages were not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: East Asia. Restaurant and drink anchors were benchmarked informally against East Asian capitals with similar cafe, night-market and mid-range dining patterns, adjusted for generally lower restaurant prices in this city. Accommodation anchors reflect budget and mid-range hostel and hotel levels typical of city-center markets in the same region.
